author: ravndal15
quote: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is boring because the gameplay can feel repetitive, the combat gets tedious, and the slow pacing makes it difficult to stay interested. The story tries too hard to be deep and emotional, while the exploration can feel dull and unrewarding. Overall, it feels overrated, and despite its beautiful visuals and soundtrack, it just isn't as entertaining or exciting as people make it out to be.
